title: Ministry of Culture raids a press conference

tellings.quote: Just look at what the Peruvian Ministry of Culture did to Joyce Mantilla during one of the press conferences around the bodies.

plain: Peru's Ministry of Culture broke up a press conference about the three-fingered bodies, small mummified figures some say are not human, and Michels points to what it did to Joyce Mantilla, one of the people presenting them, as an example. He tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that Peruvian officials were trying to shut down attention to the bodies.
